description: Backend scaffold: FastAPI app, project tooling, config/secrets layer, Cognito JWT auth, DB adapter interface + PostgreSQL adapter + schema introspection with TTL cache, request/response models, redacted logging, /health. Establishes the running backend skeleton all later features build on. Must import cleanly and pass ruff/black.
steps: Create backend/pyproject.toml targeting Python 3.11 with deps: fastapi, uvicorn[standard], gunicorn, pydantic>=2, pydantic-settings, sqlglot, python-jose[cryptography], httpx, cachetools, psycopg[binary], boto3; dev deps: pytest, pytest-asyncio, ruff, black, mypy, respx. Configure [tool.ruff] and [tool.black] (line-length 100). Add [tool.pytest.ini_options] with testpaths=tests.

Create backend/app/__init__.py and backend/app/main.py with a create_app() factory: CORS middleware (origins from settings), mounts routers, exposes GET /health returning {status:'ok'} (unauthenticated, for ALB). Export `app = create_app()`.

Create backend/app/config.py using pydantic-settings BaseSettings: AWS_REGION, COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID, COGNITO_APP_CLIENT_ID, COGNITO_ISSUER (derived), AI provider keys (GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, BEDROCK_* ), AI_PROVIDER_ORDER (default 'gemini,bedrock,openai,anthropic'), SCHEMA_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS (default 300), CORS_ORIGINS, ENABLE_DATA_SAMPLING default False, EXPLAIN_ENABLED default False. Add a helper to load secrets from AWS Secrets Manager when SECRETS_MANAGER_SECRET_ID is set (lazy, best-effort, falls back to env). env_prefix none; reads .env.

Create backend/app/logging_utils.py: a redaction helper that scrubs password/connection-string/api-key patterns and known sensitive keys from log records; a get_logger() helper. Ensure DB passwords and AI keys can never be logged.

Create backend/app/auth/cognito.py: fetch and cache JWKS from COGNITO_ISSUER/.well-known/jwks.json (cachetools TTL), verify_token(token) validating signature, issuer, audience/client id, exp, token_use=='access' (or id as configured); returns claims incl `sub`. Create backend/app/auth/deps.py with a FastAPI dependency get_current_user that extracts Bearer token and returns the Cognito sub + claims; raise 401 on failure. Make JWKS fetch injectable so tests can supply a local RSA key.

Create backend/app/db/base.py defining a DBAdapter abstract interface: test_connection(), introspect_schema() -> NormalizedSchema, sample_column(table, column, limit) for opt-in sampling. Define normalized schema dataclasses/Pydantic models in backend/app/models/schema_models.py (Schema, Table, Column, Index, ForeignKey, dialect). Create backend/app/db/postgres.py implementing the adapter with psycopg using information_schema/pg_catalog queries (read-only; parameterized; never executes arbitrary user SQL). Create backend/app/db/factory.py mapping dialect name -> adapter, with clear NotImplemented placeholders for mysql/sqlserver/sqlite/oracle so the interface is ready.

Create backend/app/services/schema.py: SchemaService that given a connection config uses the adapter to introspect, normalizes, and caches the NormalizedSchema in an in-memory cachetools TTLCache keyed by (cognito_sub, connection fingerprint). Provides get_schema(force_refresh) and optional sampling gated by settings.ENABLE_DATA_SAMPLING and a per-request opt-in flag, with a sensitive-column exclude list.

Create backend/app/models/api_models.py: Pydantic request/response models (ConnectionConfig with pydantic SecretStr password, ValidateRequest{sql,dialect,connection_id?}, ValidationResult{syntax_errors,schema_errors,warnings,parsed_statements,is_valid}, OptimizeRequest, OptimizeResponse{original_sql,suggested_sql,explanation,optimizations[],provider,is_suggestion_valid,performance_note}).

Create backend/app/api/health.py (router, redundant with main /health is fine), backend/app/api/connections.py (POST test connection + introspect schema; stores connection metadata in-memory keyed by sub; passwords never returned), wiring these routers in main.py behind get_current_user except /health.

Create backend/tests/conftest.py with fixtures: a FastAPI TestClient, a fake DBAdapter returning a small fixed NormalizedSchema (tables users(id,email,created_at), orders(id,user_id,total,status)), and a helper that generates an RSA keypair + signs a fake Cognito JWT so auth deps can be exercised without live Cognito.
Create backend/tests/test_health_and_auth.py: /health returns 200 without auth; a protected route returns 401 without token and 200 with a valid signed token (via injected JWKS).
Run `uv venv --python 3.11 && uv pip install -e '.[dev]'`, then `ruff check .`, `black --check .`, `python -c 'import app.main'`, and `uv run pytest -q`. Fix issues until all pass.
acceptance_criteria: `python -c 'import app.main'` succeeds inside the backend venv
`uv run pytest -q` passes: /health is 200 unauthenticated, protected route is 401 without and 200 with a valid signed JWT (JWKS injected, no live Cognito)
No DB password or AI key is ever written to logs or returned in a response (verified by redaction helper + model design)
verification: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run black --check . && uv run pytest -q
findings:
Backend scaffold implemented under backend/. Verified with: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run black --check . && python -c 'import app.main' && uv run pytest -q (all pass, 5 tests). Key notes for later features:
- Python 3.11.16 venv created via `uv venv --python 3.11`; uv.lock is committed. Default system python3 is 3.9 - always use the backend/.venv or `uv run`.
- ruff config lives in [tool.ruff.lint] (ruff 0.17); select E,F,I,W,UP,B; B008 ignored to allow FastAPI Depends() defaults. Line length 100 for ruff+black.
- App factory: app/main.py create_app(settings=None) -> FastAPI; module-level `app = create_app()`. CORS origins from settings.cors_origins_list. /health is public; other routers enforce auth per-route via Depends(get_current_user).
- Config: app/config.py Settings (pydantic-settings, case_insensitive, extra=ignore, reads .env). COGNITO_ISSUER is a computed_field. get_settings() is lru_cached and calls load_secrets_from_secrets_manager() first (best-effort, never overwrites existing env). AI_PROVIDER_ORDER default 'gemini,bedrock,openai,anthropic'; helpers ai_provider_order_list / cors_origins_list. SENSITIVE_COLUMN_NAMES list available.
- Auth: app/auth/cognito.py CognitoVerifier(settings, jwks_provider, cache_ttl_seconds) with INJECTABLE jwks_provider (TTLCache). verify_token checks RS256 sig, issuer, exp, token_use (access by default; access tokens validate client_id from claims since python-jose can't check client_id as aud, verify_aud disabled for access). app/auth/deps.py get_current_user -> CurrentUser(sub, claims); verifier resolved from request.app.state.cognito_verifier (tests inject it). HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) so missing token -> 401 (not 403).
- DB: app/db/base.py DBAdapter ABC (test_connection, introspect_schema->NormalizedSchema, sample_column). app/db/postgres.py PostgresAdapter uses psycopg[binary], read-only parameterized information_schema/pg_catalog, never runs user SQL; sample_column validates identifiers against catalog then uses psycopg.sql.Identifier. app/db/factory.py create_adapter(config) -> postgres impl; mysql/sqlserver/sqlite/oracle raise NotImplementedError placeholders; unknown dialect raises ValueError.
- Models: app/models/schema_models.py (Column, Index, ForeignKey, Table, Schema; NormalizedSchema = Schema alias). app/models/api_models.py has ConnectionConfig (password: SecretStr, .fingerprint()), ConnectionInfo (no password), TestConnectionResponse, ValidateRequest, ValidationResult, OptimizeRequest, OptimizeResponse - ready for FEAT-002/003 to populate.
- Services: app/services/schema.py SchemaService(settings, adapter_factory=create_adapter) with TTLCache keyed by (cognito_sub, connection fingerprint); get_schema(sub, config, force_refresh), invalidate(), sample_column() gated by settings.ENABLE_DATA_SAMPLING + per-request opt_in + sensitive-column exclusion. Resolved from request.app.state.schema_service.
- API: app/api/health.py (GET /health public). app/api/connections.py POST /connections/test (test+introspect, stores config in-memory per sub, returns table_count, no password), GET /connections (list, no passwords). In-memory store `_connections` is module-level with a Lock.
- Logging: app/logging_utils.py redact()/RedactionFilter/configure_logging/get_logger scrub passwords, connection strings, bearer tokens, and known sensitive keys. Use get_logger(__name__).
- Tests: tests/conftest.py builds a local RSA keypair, exposes JWKS, Signer.sign() mints fake Cognito access tokens (kid 'test-key-1'), injects CognitoVerifier + SchemaService with a FakeAdapter (users(id,email,created_at), orders(id,user_id,total,status)). Reuse these fixtures for FEAT-002/003 route tests. No live DB/Cognito/AI needed.
- Placed .gitignore (ignores .venv, .env, __pycache__, caches, frontend/dist/node_modules) and backend/.env.example at repo root/backend.
